data.long_meaning: Sidh (achiever) + Antha (goal) = Achiever of Goals. Sidhanth is a name for a knowledge seeker, someone who is always striving to learn and grow. The name Sidhanth carries the meaning “Achiever of Goals, Knowledge Seeker” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Sidhanth usually hope their child will grow to embody achiever of goals, knowledge seeker and live with faith, good character and purpose.
